name: qa-do
description: Route a plain-language QA situation to the next 1-2 skills, then carry out the requested workflow with evidence and a readable report. Use ONLY when the request does not match any other skill's trigger phrases. Use when: "which skill should I use," "where do I start," "validate this app," "run QA and report," "/qa-do," or any vague QA situation that doesn't map to one skill. Not for: bootstrapping a brand-new project with no QA — use qa-start. Not for: capturing project setup/context — use qa-project-context. If the request clearly matches another skill, invoke that skill directly instead of routing through here. Related: qa-start, qa-project-context, test-strategy.
